theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_scf_monotonicity_identity
theorems.statement: StationaryMonotonicityIdentity → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), C.Stationary → ∀ y : Euclidean N, (∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → θ + (unitBallVolume n)⁻¹ * normalDefect C y (closedBall y ρ) = densityRatio n C.weight y ρ) ∧ MonotoneOn (densityRatio n C.weight y) (Ioi 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
